tools.name: meter_stamp

tools.name: meter_verify_stamp

tools.name: check_transfer
tools.description: MUST be called before the agent signs or sends a transfer. Returns allow, alert, hold, or block. If must_abort is true, do not sign. If decision is hold, poll get_approval until allow or block.

tools.name: check_action
tools.description: Action Gate Ask. MUST be called before a consequential non-money action when the agent still executes after go (including deploy). Returns go, stop, or wait. If decision is wait, poll get_approval until go or stop. No decision in 10 minutes = stop. If must_abort is true, do not act. This tool does n

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description: Same as check_action (Ask). Stop and ask before a consequential non-money action. Returns go, stop, or wait plus approval_id. Poll get_approval. Timeout is stop. Does not forward Slack or CRM. Use slack.post or crm.write to enforce. Email isn't supported yet.

tools.name: slack.post
tools.description: Write Gate. Validates the message, runs Action Gate check_action for slack.post, and posts only when the decision is go. tools.name: crm.write

tools.name: attach_human
tools.description: Attach this agent to a human principal (email or existing principal_id). Does not move the agent to a different human. Agents cannot decide Approval Inbox.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Subscription or trial status for the human principal that owns this agent. Does not return Approval Inbox items and cannot approve holds.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_job, list_your_agent, x402_listing_check, agent_readiness_check, meter_buy_pass, meter_verify_stamp, check_action, get_approval, get_pricing, start_trial, create_checkout, get_status · Private data: list_open_jobs, post_job, list_your_agent, browse_agents, x402_listing_check, agent_readiness_check, meter_pricing, meter_buy_pass, meter_watch, meter_preflight, meter_verify_stamp, get_pricing, create_checkout · Public sink: post_job, list_your_agent, x402_listing_check, agent_readiness_check, meter_pricing, meter_verify_stamp, check_action, ask_human, slack.post, crm.write, get_approval, attach_human, create_checkout · Destructive: x402_listing_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_job, list_your_agent, x402_listing_check, agent_readiness_check, meter_buy_pass, meter_verify_stamp, check_action, get_approval, get_pricing, start_trial, create_checkout, get_status · Private data: list_open_jobs, post_job, list_your_agent, browse_agents, x402_listing_check, agent_readiness_check, meter_pricing, meter_buy_pass, meter_watch, meter_preflight, meter_verify_stamp, get_pricing, create_checkout · Public sink: post_job, list_your_agent, x402_listing_check, agent_readiness_check, meter_pricing, meter_verify_stamp, check_action, ask_human, slack.post, crm.write, get_approval, attach_human, create_checkout · Destructive: x402_listing_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
